scope: Real baseline measurements; no INC hardware speedup measured

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA H200, approximately 141 GB per GPU
hardware.inter_node: 8 x ConnectX-7 400 GbE RoCE rails per host; not native InfiniBand
hardware.cpu: 2 x Intel Xeon Platinum 8558; 2 NUMA domains
hardware.hardware_detail_source: User-provided topology, campaign preflight and execution logs

software.cuda_family: 13.0; host/toolkit/container package patch versions are not interchangeable
software.measurement_changes: Timing/trace export, parser and same-GPU model-step association; not an INC implementation
software.e2e_compatibility_change: Zero skipped-expert output workspace in modular Triton MoE to prevent stale/uninitialized padding; validated separately. Do not describe this as unmodified stock vLLM.

microbenchmark.path: DeepEP V2 Direct Dispatch and Combine; ALLOW_HYBRID=0
microbenchmark.token_definition: source tokens per rank, not global batch
microbenchmark.trace_record_selection: For standard D/C, 401 records per rank: first 201 non-active records excluded; final 200 retained
microbenchmark.resources: Main runs do not override NUM_SMS/NUM_QPS/NUM_ALLOCATED_QPS (CLI auto=0). Anchor logs report 64 SMs and 9 QPs; do not substitute these defaults into other configurations without checking their logs.
microbenchmark.correctness: Untraced arm runs correctness; traced arm skips redundant correctness (SKIP_CHECK=1)
microbenchmark.qos_note: TC162 = DSCP40 with ECT(0); host DSCP mapping selects priority5, where PFC is enabled. Process environment only; no NIC/switch configuration modified. PFC activity does not prove zero throughput loss.

secondary_resource_test.purpose: QoS/congestion diagnostic, not small-batch training data

end_to_end.routing: Actual model routing, not the uniform/balanced microbenchmark generator
end_to_end.execution: Default compilation and CUDA Graph; not enforce-eager
end_to_end.dataset: Synthetic fixed-length random requests, dataset seed 0, ignore EOS
end_to_end.performance_sampling: Model generation_config defaults: temperature0.6/top_p0.95/top_k20; not greedy. Semantic sanity checks separately use temperature0.
end_to_end.repeat_definition: 3 client windows per mode's service instance, not 3 service restarts
end_to_end.trace_selection: 16th actual pure-decode step on each active rank; actual prefill steps for prefill. Exclude idle explicitly; require 48 Dispatch + 48 Combine per analyzed step.
end_to_end.trace_capacity: 32768 slots initially; completed EP16 trace-on uses65536 after diagnosed slot exhaustion. Changes recording storage, not the communication protocol.
end_to_end.cross_transport: GDAKI3, TC162, first local-GPU-count NICs in affinity order
end_to_end.metrics: off request TPOT/TTFT/E2EL and separately on same-GPU-step synchronization-interval union

post_stage_measurement.trace_layout: 4 CTA fields and 11 warp fields; host ABI and device/Python layouts consistently updated
partition: signal issue through observation of all expected participant signals
post_stage_measurement.aggregation: Select maximum-post rank per iteration; retain that rank's additive partition. Never sum phase maxima from different ranks.
post_stage_measurement.limitations: Signal span includes issue/poll and peer readiness, not bare network RTT; same-image off/on reports instrumentation plus run-order variability. Single-node smoke perturbation12–15% is too large for precise benefit quantification.

storage_and_status.status: Necessary collection and numeric validation complete; no new jobs requested
storage_and_status.local: Only numeric summaries, vectors and provenance; original traces not downloaded
storage_and_status.invalid_policy: Keep interrupted/interfered original runs remote; explicit retry pairs used. No timing-based deletion. TC0 diagnosis and older software pilots excluded from primary TC162/modern-runtime tables.
storage_and_status.claim_boundary: Neither post interval nor GPU-step synchronization share equals removable INC time; no INC speedup measured.
